sentences.text: ORAL ORDER

This petition is filed by the husband and in-laws seeking quashing of the charge sheet in C.C. No.
867/2024 (arising out of Crime No. 22/2024 of Dakshina Kannada Women's Police Station, Puttur Sub-Division), pending before the Principal Civil Judge and JMFC, Puttur, D.K., for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 448, 504, 506 read with Section 34 of the IPC, insofar as the petitioners are concerned.

entities.text: Dakshina Kannada Women's Police Station, Puttur
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. During the pendency of the petition, an application is filed under Section 528 read with Section 359 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, seeking permission to compound the offences and consequently quash the entire proceedings in C.C. No. 867/2024.

The application is accompanied by the affidavits of respondent No. 2/defacto complainant and petitioner No.
1/husband, wherein it is stated that the parties have reconciled their differences and arrived at an amicable NC: 2025:KHC:30838 HC-KAR settlement within the family, leading to their reunion.
Both have requested the Court to quash the proceedings in view of the settlement.
3. On being queried, respondent No. 2 confirmed the settlement and stated that no undue pressure or coercion had been exerted upon her.
She affirmed that she had voluntarily agreed to put an end to the disputes between her, her husband, and her in-laws.
4. Respondent No. 2 further submitted that following the reunion, she has returned to Dubai and is presently residing with petitioner No. 1/husband.
In light of the affidavits filed and the voluntary nature of the settlement, the application for compounding is allowed, and the offences are permitted to be compounded.
5. The affidavits are taken on record.
As the offences are compoundable in law, the application for compounding stands allowed.
NC: 2025:KHC:30838 HC-KAR 6.
Consequently, the criminal petition is allowed.

The entire proceedings in C.C. No. 867/2024 (arising from Crime No. 22/2024 registered by Dakshina Kannada Women's Police Station, Puttur Sub-Division) pending on the file of Principal Civil Judge and JMFC Court, Puttur, D.K. registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 448, 504, 506 and 149 IPC.
